summary: Iter 15 — frontend-only e2e validation of 6 new ProMappingStudio features (select tool + 8 handles + rotate, stylus-only, trace auto-straighten, grid editor, popup suppression, lock-per-element). 18 of 21 spec checks PASS via Playwright; 1 likely real bug found in auto-straighten path; 2 test-side issues (case-sensitive matching + wrong svg rect selector) that did NOT indicate functional failure (verified visually in the smoke screenshot at /tmp/iter15_smoke.png).

ui_bugs.issue: When a near-perfectly-straight stroke is traced with freehand OFF, the cleaned point list returned by rdpSimplify can collapse to exactly 2 points. isNearStraight() in /app/frontend/src/lib/pro-mapping-v2.js (line 228) returns FALSE for points.length<3, so the element is committed as kind='trace' instead of kind='line'. Verified via inspector list: traced (0.30, 0.65) → (0.70, 0.66) (Δy = 0.01 over Δx = 0.40) with freehand OFF and inspector showed kind 'trace' (NOT 'line'). Spec requires 'line' for near-straight strokes when freehand is OFF.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG: /app/frontend/src/lib/pro-mapping-v2.js isNearStraight (line 228) returns false when points.length<3. When a user traces a perfectly straight stroke, rdpSimplify with tolerance=0.002 may reduce the cleaned point set to exactly 2 points, after which the auto-straighten branch is skipped and the element commits as 'trace' instead of 'line'. Fix: in /app/frontend/src/components/app/ProMappingStudio.jsx onPointerUp (line 357), additionally treat cleaned.points.length===2 with sufficient endpoint distance as 'straight enough', OR change isNearStraight to return true when points.length===2 and len > 0.02.

ProMappingStudio.jsx is now ~1100 lines with the new select/grid/rotate logic — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Split candidates: SelectionFrame + GridEditOverlay + DraftOverlay + MarkupOverlay (~250 lines) into a separate canvas-overlays module; CleanReconstructionCanvas + CleanElement + CleanTextLayer + valueForField (~225 lines) into CleanReconstructionCanvas.jsx; InspectorPane + AssetsPane (~80 lines) into StudioDockPanes.jsx.

Handle hit-testing in onPointerDown (line 132) uses fixed handleR=0.018 in normalized space. On phones at zoom=1, this is ~10px which is below the WCAG 24px touch-target minimum. Consider scaling handle hit area by 1/zoom so handles remain ergonomic at 0.5x zoom.

translateGeometry/resizeGeometry handle most kinds but logo_anchor and qr_anchor are NOT fully covered for resize when mode==='center' — they switch to scale-as-width on resize, which mutates the meaning of 'scale'. Document or normalize.
selectedEl is recomputed on every render via .find() (line 64). For schemas with many elements, memoize via useMemo keyed by (selectedId, schema.elements).

stylus-only mode also blocks pointerType==='mouse' which is fine on a tablet but will break desktop drivers if they're testing the layout. Consider exempting non-touch devices (e.g. window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)') override).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Path into Studio confirmed identical to iter 14: cookie session → /templates → pick-scan → set_input_files on template-setup-file-input → mapmode-pro → template-setup-continue-map → studio mounts. Default tool is now 'select'. Tools other than select+boundary stay disabled until 4 anchors are placed (verified by visual disabled state). When testing drag-move/resize/rotate via Playwright, AVOID querySelector('svg rect') — the FIRST rect is the working-area dashed bounds rendered before elements. Use querySelectorAll then index from end, or filter by stroke color, or read schema.elements via React DevTools state. The studio-canvas viewBox is 0..1 normalized; coordinates from getBoundingClientRect must be divided by canvas width/height to compare with internal SVG coords. The freehand toggle is ONLY rendered when tool==='trace'. Grid editor text uses uppercase ('1 COLS', '1 ROWS') so case-insensitive match is recommended. Smoke screenshot at /tmp/iter15_smoke.png shows a working selection state (rect placed in center of mapping pane, action bar visible to its right).
rca of the issue: Auto-straighten regression — RCA: rdpSimplify(points, tolerance=0.002) is aggressive enough to reduce a screen-perfect straight stroke to exactly 2 endpoint samples. The downstream isNearStraight(points, 0.012) guards with `if (!points || points.length < 3) return false`, on the assumption that a 2-point list is degenerate. Combined effect: a stroke that IS straight gets rejected from the auto-straighten branch and falls through to the trace branch, committing as kind='trace'. Reproduction: switch to trace tool with freehand OFF, drag a near-horizontal straight line; inspector shows kind='trace' (expected 'line'). Mitigation: in onPointerUp, when cleaned.points.length===2 AND dist(cleaned.points[0], cleaned.points[1]) > 0.02, route to the line-commit branch; OR amend isNearStraight to: `if (points.length === 2) return Math.hypot(points[1].x-points[0].x, points[1].y-points[0].y) > 0.02;`.
